title: Nautilus Update (From your guy's suggestions!)
author: Content_Mind_196
selftext:
Made the unterraformed world barren! (I'm already in the mid-game which is why you don't see it TOO MUCH here.) and have improved the animations and performance of the game, reworking all the plants and adding a few dozen more creatures! (I only showcased the starter biome.)

Last post alot of people had some really good Idea's to bring to the table that I've added to the game so feel free to reply any comments/questions/suggestions!

I've used a few million output tokens so far, using the godot engine and claude code!
